title: Folk theories of everything else turned out wrong

statements.text: Folk physics, folk biology and folk epidemiology all proved radically mistaken. Since folk theories generally turn out mistaken, and the mind-brain is far more complex than motion, fire, heat, the weather or disease, it would be astonishing if folk psychology alone among folk theories were essentially correct.

sources.locator: section 3.1, 'General Theoretical Problems With Folk Psychology'
sources.quote: Since folk theories generally turn out to be mistaken, it seems quite improbable that folk psychology will turn out true.
it would be astonishing if folk psychology , alone among folk theories, was essentially correct
